description: This file defines data models used for managing chat sessions and choices within the OpenClawChatUI component of the project. It includes structures for representing chat models, session defaults, session entries, and response lists, all conforming to Codable and related protocols for serialization and identification.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializers for each data structure to create instances with provided parameters.

methods.name: selectionID
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for a chat model choice, combining provider and modelID.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Returns a display label for the chat model choice, based on its selectionID.
